authority.closed: The R3 specification, freeze, DEV and QUAL records and the R3 laboratory are read, never edited. Cognitive R0, Runtime R1, Retention R0/R1/R2 and RR2-CR0 are not touched.

comparisons.boundaries: after A, B, C and D (each consolidated): epoch exact (4000, 8000, 12000, 16000); provenance COMPLETE; W, packed H and a within tolerance of the recomputed reference; the native query of W on every experience's held-out inputs within tolerance of the reference responses; native nmse of every experience within tolerance of the recorded nmse; nothing refused
comparisons.classification: the R3 classes (LEARNED, RETAINED, CATASTROPHIC, HELD, SEQUENCE_HELD, PAIR_HELD) recomputed from native nmse equal the recorded K1 classes exactly
comparisons.determinism: two fresh native runs of the first QUAL world give bitwise identical envelopes at every boundary
comparisons.disposition: the R3 gates (experiment.gates, unchanged) applied to the recorded per-world record with the native K1 rows, the native K1-disabled rows (state removal) and the native causal branches substituted give validity, mechanics, gates A-K, disposition, outcome and controls equal to the recorded pre-robustness decision record, and every per-world K1 and causality row equal to the recorded one
comparisons.reset_challenge: restore the native envelope after B, reset: W and epoch bitwise kept, H = 0, a = 0, provenance RESET; learn C, evaluate at the C boundary, stop (no D, no consolidation): e_reset within nmse tolerance of the recorded e_reset; RESET_DEGRADED and both_retained_at_C equal the recorded values exactly
comparisons.resident_equals_standalone: the FMS-resident sequence yields envelopes bitwise equal to the standalone sequence at every boundary
comparisons.state_semantics: at B the full native state and its reset answer every held-out query bitwise identically; learning C from them differs
comparisons.transplant_continuation: the native envelope after B, restored in a fresh state and continued through C and D (same transactions), gives envelopes bitwise equal to the uninterrupted native run at C and D, in process and in a separate clean process
comparisons.w_a: the native W after learning A from w0 equals the recorded K1 W_A digest bitwise
comparisons.w_only_negative_control: the Runtime R1 ELPISG01 snapshot of native W_B imports as UNCONSOLIDATED_IMPORT (H = 0, a = 0, W bitwise, envelope differs from the full B envelope); learning C from it equals the native reset branch bitwise and differs from the uninterrupted native C state; pass equals the recorded pass
comparisons.zero_k1_parity: a native K1 state that is never consolidated (H = 0, a = 0) learns A, B, C, D from w0: its W digest equals the recorded M0 W digest at every boundary of every world, bitwise; no step is corrected. K1-disabled execution is Runtime R1 G1.

disclosures: Before this plan the native law was compared with the R3 laboratory on one world outside both R3 splits (id test-0003; development smoke in a scratch script, not recorded): W relative difference 7.5e-15 after 4000 corrected steps, H and a at rounding level. No R3 DEV or QUAL world had been run through native K1.
The native unit tests (native/ECS_G/tests/test_ecsg_k1*.c, tests/ECS_G/test_k1_runtime.py) use synthetic data only.
name: ecsg-k1-native

native_paths.control: elpis.ECS_G.k1 (Python control plane: one native call per operation)
native_paths.resident: elpis_ecsg_k1_fms: the same sequence on an FMS-resident state (pin, native K1 on resident bytes, unpin)
native_paths.standalone: elpis_ecsg_k1: each experience is one transaction (txn_begin, txn_learn of 4000 steps in one call, txn_consolidate of the experience inputs, txn_commit)

purpose: Differential qualification of the native K1 runtime (libelpis_ecsg_k1, libelpis_ecsg_k1_fms) against the frozen Retention R3 science. Nativeization may not change OUTCOME_A.

reference.recomputed: the unchanged R3 laboratory (research/ecs_retention_r3) recomputed in the same process for the quantities the record keeps only as digests (W, packed H, a, responses); whether that recomputation reproduces the recorded K1 state digests bitwise is reported, not decided on
reference.recorded: the R3 QUAL record: per-stage nmse, classes, digests, causal results and the decision record

regime: inherited unchanged from the R3 specification: d = 6, N = 36, F = 83, G1 rate 0.002, 4000 steps per experience, 64 rows, hidden gain 2.0
relative_difference: max |native - reference| / max(1, max |reference|) over all entries
runs: the qualification runs once from this plan and writes its record exclusively; tests/research/ecs_k1_native re-runs the differential on the current runtime (never skipped for a host difference) against the same tolerances
tolerance_rationale: The native K1 correction sums the same terms in a different order than the NumPy laboratory (packed symmetric mat-vec and an index-table S3 VJP); differences are rounding only. The tolerances are fixed here, before any R3 QUAL world is run through native K1, and are not host-specific: the same values bind every host and the current-runtime regression.

verdict.NOT_QUALIFIED: anything else; the native milestone is not promoted and the failure is recorded as found
verdict.QUALIFIED: every comparison holds on every QUAL world and the substituted decision record reproduces OUTCOME_A

worlds.data: rebuilt from the R3 specification by research/ecs_retention_r3/task.py (seeded, deterministic)
worlds.set: every R3 QUAL world, in the recorded order
